watch.summary: The creator laughs in disbelief while watching a clip of humanoid robots running and making unnaturally huge leaps on a track.

beats.what: Creator plays a Twitter video about a new method for running robots.
The creator starts laughing at how the robot on the left is moving.
The camera zooms in on the robot taking huge, bizarre leaping strides.
Creator laughs and asks 'What is this, bro?'
Creator holds his hands up describing how terrifying it would be to see that jumping at you in real life.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Can you imagine that jumping? That is literally the scariest thing to imagine.
watch.why: The visual of a robot taking giant, comical leaps down a track is instantly funny on its own. The creator's genuine laughter and dramatic reaction to how terrifying it looks adds to the comedy.
